// diagnostic

L0528

This mutable binding receives no later write, so its mutability is unused

What

This mutable binding receives no later write, so its mutability is unused

Why

The binding is marked mutable but receives no later write.

Fix

Declare it with `::` instead of `:=`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0528: tests/ui_lint/arrow_loop_value_drop.warn.

Warning [L0528] (mutable_never_reassigned): This mutable binding receives no later write, so its mutability is unused
  --> arrow_loop_value_drop.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     values := [1, 2]
    |     ^^^^^^
 Why: The binding is marked mutable but receives no later write.
 Fix: Declare it with `::` instead of `:=`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/L0528

Warning [L0508] (arrow_loop_value_drop): This arrow loop body computes a value and drops it
  --> arrow_loop_value_drop.jet:3:25
    |
  3 |     loop v in values -> v * 2
    |                         ^^^^^
 Why: A statement-position loop arrow discards its body's value; the loop takes write access (&) for items when it updates the source
 Fix: Bind the loop with `::` to collect its values, or write `loop v in &values -> v *= 2` so it takes write access (&) for items
More: jet-lang.dev/e/L0508
